observed.caption: A white and blue shuttle bus is parked on a dusty urban street with pedestrians and the tall Kahawa House building in the background.
observed.description: The photo shows a paved urban street with a reddish dirt shoulder in the foreground and center. A large white bus with blue stripes is positioned in the middle of the road, with several people standing and walking on the dirt and pavement nearby. Behind the bus, a large brown multi-story building with a vertical sign dominates the center background, flanked by other high-rise buildings with green, beige, and white facades to the right and a stone building with a tiled roof on the far right. A small red car is parked on the right side near a metal fence with people standing beside it, and additional vehicles including a black car on the left and a blue van behind the main bus are visible further down the street. The sky is partly cloudy with bright daylight illuminating the scene.
